Meningioma: The histopathological examination showing uniform partly spindle-shaped tumor cells with oval nuclei and intranuclear clear inclusions, along with the presence of whorl formation and psammoma bodies, is consistent with meningioma. The weak expression of epithelial membrane antigen (EMA), vimentin, and S-100 also supports this diagnosis.
